description: Risk Data Hub Atlas (EU JRC Disaster Risk Management Knowledge Centre) is a data resource listed in Risk Data Library, an initiative and catalogue for disaster and climate risk data, published or maintained by European Commission Joint Research Centre. It is the European Commission Joint Research Centre atlas of disaster risk data, described by the Risk Data Library as the first application of its standard in a regional risk data catalogue. Coverage: Europe. The atlas is a script-driven application; its dataset list was not readable with the tools used, so its individual datasets are not yet catalogued. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-gfdrr-risk-data-library-standard.
